input.quote: (j) This Agreement constitutes the entire Agreement between the parties with respect to its subject matter, and this Agreement supersedes all prior understandings, representations, negotiations and communications between the parties, oral and written.
input.rationale: No insurance covenant exists anywhere in the Agreement: searches for "insurance", "coverage", "certificate" and "workers' compensation" return nothing, and § 20 (General Matters, subsections (a)-(j)) ends with the entire-agreement clause. Garman personnel attend Authorized Locations for installation, data conversion and training and handle Sparkling data, so an uninsured vendor is walk-away territory under the rule. We insert a short § 20(k) at the preferred level (CGL USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate, E&O USD 2M, cyber/privacy USD 5M where Sparkling data is processed, statutory workers' compensation, certificates on request), omitting ancillary expense and survival language not required by the checklist.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no insurance covenant even though Garman personnel attend our Authorized Locations and handle our data, so we have added a standard insurance paragraph at § 20(k) (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M where our data is processed, statutory workers' compensation, certificates on request). We can fall back to E&O USD 1M and cyber USD 2M if the full programme is an issue.

ops.text: (k) Garman shall maintain commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; where Garman processes any data belonging to, supplied by, or processed for Sparkling, cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000; and workers' compensation insurance as required by law. Garman shall provide certificates of insurance on request.

mappings.element: Commercial general liability coverage is at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.
Commercial general liability coverage is at least USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate.
Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.
If Vendor processes Customer Data, cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 5,000,000.
Vendor maintains workers' compensation coverage as required by law.
Vendor provides certificates of insurance on request.
